Do you see this as the opportunity to start working as a logistics employee at this company? With a gross hourly wage of €15.40, good employment conditions, and plenty of opportunities to grow, this is your moment! Read the vacancy quickly and don’t forget to apply. Who knows, you might soon be starting your new job!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for logistics employees for a company based in Eemshaven.

As a logistics employee, you will work in a large, sustainable warehouse at a leading logistics company. Your tasks include packing and unpacking goods, checking orders using packing lists, sorting parts, and physically moving racks and trays. Safety is a top priority, which is why a VCA certificate is required (we can help you get one), and you must be able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG). Experience is not required, making this a great opportunity to start a career in logistics.

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.40 per hour
    
- Travel allowance according to the client’s policy
    
- Full-time job of 37.5 hours per week
    
- Chance of a temporary contract with the prospect of permanent employment
    
- Free development opportunities through the Manpower Academy with over 200 online courses
    
- Working in a clean and safe warehouse following 5S principles
    
- Opportunity to develop and grow within a large, sustainable organization

    - Minimum of MBO level or equivalent
    
- Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)
    
- Willingness to work full time
    
- Accuracy and a proactive attitude
    
- VCA is a plus, but not mandatory
    
- Proficiency in English is important (it’s the working language there)
    
- Own transportation is required due to difficult accessibility

Is this your new job? Don’t wait any longer and apply today! Manpower will contact you within two working days to discuss the next steps.

Looking for a stable full-time job in logistics within a clean, modern, and high-tech working environment? Join a growing international company where you'll work with great colleagues and contribute to the logistics process behind some of the world's leading technology companies.
As a Logistics Employee, you are responsible for ensuring a smooth flow of materials throughout the production process. You make sure materials are delivered to the right place at the right time, preventing delays and disruptions.

Your responsibilities include:

- Transporting materials to and from the production floor.
- Ensuring a smooth and efficient material flow throughout the warehouse and production areas.
- Operating an EPT, stacker, (and forklift) safely and efficiently.
- Identifying and resolving logistical issues, escalating them to your supervisor when necessary.
- Supporting inventory management by performing stock counts and inventory checks.
- Following safety procedures and maintaining an organized workplace.
- Working closely with colleagues to ensure daily operational targets are achieved.

- Some experience in logistics or warehouse operations
- Valid EPT, stacker, and forklift certificates with practical experience
- Good command of the English language (minimum B1; B2 is preferred)
- Able to work independently while also being a strong team player
- Accurate, flexible, and proactive
- Available for a full-time position in a two-shift schedule

jobs.description:
Are you a morning bird and you love having your afternoons free? Then this is the perfect job for you! Start your day surrounded by the scent of fresh flowers. As an order picker at Royal FloraHolland in Aalsmeer, you make a difference every morning. You’ll work with a large, friendly team and make sure flowers and plants get to the right customer on time. Your shift starts at 6:00 AM, so you can enjoy your free afternoons after your work. Ideal if you enjoy active work and having your afternoons open!Every day is different. You pick up your cart full of flowers and distribute them to the carts of customers. You use a headset to hear exactly where your flowers need to go. You smoothly drive an electric cart through the logistics hall. No license required, we teach you everything you need to know. You lift beautiful plants and flowers from your cart to the customer’s cart. You also check orders and help with other logistics tasks. You work in a nice flow and see the results of your work immediately.Do you want to be active, see results quickly, and work in an enthusiastic team? Join us! - You are at least 18 years old;

- You are fit and able to lift flower carts;

- You are at least 1.65 meters tall because of safety reasons
- You can start at 6:00 AM in Aalsmeer

- You are available at least 2 weekday mornings per week

- You can work for at least 7 months

- You speak good Dutch or English

- You can provide a certificate of good conduct (we pay for it)
- 
If you do not have a certificate of good conduct yet, you can request one (we will help you with this)

- Experiance with job tasks mentioned abowe.

- Goon English language skills - speaking

- Driving licence is a big plus - B

- Good with working in a group

Arranged an paid transport to work and back

Paid transport to Holland - place of work

Weekly salary on Dutch contract - salary 18,00 to 19,00€ NET

Provided PPE

If you are interested please apply.
